data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'ayn' which means 'life' or 'breath'. In Arabic culture, the name Ayana is given to girls symbolizing the beginning of life and the essence of breath. The name Ayana carries the meaning “Life, breath” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ayana usually hope their child will grow to embody life, breath and live with faith, good character and purpose.
